case.summary: Case CASE-015 involves three card-not-present transactions (4012177, 4012178, 4012179) on card SC-03015-K952 totaling $453.49 in exposure. The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012177 ($194.42, domestic) at 0.82 [EV-6b17754e]. The transaction originated from a previously unseen device (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) [EV-2e815d59] and used an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-c548cba1]. Three online transactions occurred within a 48-hour window [EV-2d4d1521], against a prior average transaction amount of $129.53 [EV-584c14cb]. The device profile appears in one prior confirmed fraud case [EV-1a5a2252], and the customer has one prior fraud case (CC-4323) [EV-43bd77cd]. The customer denies authorizing the purchases and reports the physical card remains in their possession [EV-4ebf4d4c]. The pattern matches six prior closed cases of 'card_not_present_new_device' [EV-4864afd9].

sar.narrative: A Suspicious Activity Report is warranted for customer SC-03015 and card SC-03015-K952. Three card-not-present transactions (4012177, 4012178, 4012179) totaling $453.49 were initiated from a new, previously unobserved device fingerprint (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) [EV-2e815d59] via an anonymous proxy connection geolocated to Argentina [EV-c548cba1]. The real-time risk model assigned a score of 0.82 to the initial transaction [EV-6b17754e]. Transaction velocity was elevated, with three online purchases occurring within 48 hours [EV-2d4d1521], exceeding the card's historical average of $129.53 per transaction [EV-584c14cb]. The device profile has been linked to one prior confirmed fraud case [EV-1a5a2252], and the customer has a prior fraud history (CC-4323) [EV-43bd77cd]. The cardholder disputes all three charges and confirms physical possession of the card [EV-4ebf4d4c]. This pattern aligns with six prior closed investigations categorized as 'card_not_present_new_device' [EV-4864afd9]. The activity is consistent with account takeover using a new device and anonymized network infrastructure.
